claims: The Oscars are held at the Dolby Theatre in Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland) on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, California.
Dolby Theatre has hosted the annual Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
Dolby Theatre is contracted to host the annual Academy Awards ceremony through 2028.
Dolby Theatre is located at Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, Hollywood, California.
Dolby Theatre is a purpose-built venue for the Academy Awards.
Dolby Theatre hosts other premier live events.
Dolby Theatre is adjacent to the historic TCL Chinese Theatre.
Dolby Theatre is surrounded by the Ovation Hollywood shopping center.
The Academy Awards ceremony occasionally takes place at other venues in Los Angeles.
Dolby Theatre is considered the primary, consistent home of the Oscars
